concept.cross_view_consistency_note: Concept dome and cutaway useful, but cross-view brown ring resembles arbitrary strata. Build single continuous broad faceted turf dome, three narrow branching summit grooves physically carved in height field, small front-right sector removed down through top to reveal solid pale-blue schematic ice section under thin brown soil contact. No circular crater or broad natural exposed ice claim. Base continuous with flat surrounding tundra.
